tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App chrome: the top nav, the hero ground and the bottom nav. The darkest layer; artwork sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background behind poster rows and content sections.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Filter band behind genre chips, sheets and raised panels.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Fill of unselected genre chips and the secondary button.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for surface-300 controls; menus over surface-200.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Translucent band for tabs laid over artwork (the hero's lower edge). Pair with a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Placeholder fill while hero art or posters load; also the poster fallback ground.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Gradient stop that fades artwork into surface-0 so hero text stays legible.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline under the top nav and between sections. Decorative only, below 3:1 by design.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: outlined icon buttons, text inputs, the inactive star outline in RatingInput. At least 3:1 on every surface, surface-300 included.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, on brand and on surface-300 chips.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav and tab labels, metadata (year, seasons, runtime), inactive card icons. 4.9:1 or better on surface-0 through surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative separators only. Fails 4.5:1 on surface-100 (2.9:1): never for readable copy or meaningful icons.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The signature red: primary buttons, selected genre chips, the active tab and nav underline, the liked heart, the wordmark. As a mark it holds 3.6:1 on surface-100; do not set small text in it — use brand-text.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand buttons and chips (ink on it 6:1).

tokens.name: brand-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for brand buttons and chips.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Red text and links under 24px on surface-0, surface-100 and surface-200 (4.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a brand fill (5:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rating stars and score numbers on cards; the filled stars in RatingInput. 8.8:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of the age-rating badge (7+, 13+, 18+).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold-deep (7.8:1). The source screenshot set the badge in pale yellow (2.2:1); this darker label replaces it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every surface (14:1 or better).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, in brand on surface-0. 28px under 768px.

styles.name: title-spaced
styles.usage: Featured title in the hero, uppercase, ink on scrim. Mobile: title-spaced-sm.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Stranded on a frozen moon, a salvage crew has one week to signal home.
styles.usage: Hero synopsis and review lead-ins, max 52ch.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Top-nav links and tab labels: ink when active, ink-muted otherwise.

styles.name: chip-label
styles.usage: Genre chips and filters, sentence case.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title under a poster, one line, truncated.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Year, runtime, vote counts, in ink-muted.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Rating numbers beside a star; tabular figures.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Age-rating badge label, on-gold on gold-deep.

styles.name: title-spaced-sm
styles.usage: Hero title on phones; letter-spacing tightens so titles wrap at word breaks.

styles.name: body-lg-sm
styles.sample: Stranded on a frozen moon, a salvage crew has one week to signal home.
styles.usage: Hero synopsis on phones; never below 16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap in score badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gaps inside meta rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between poster cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between poster cards on desktop; padding inside panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between hero blocks (meta, title, synopsis, actions).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between page sections on phones; tab gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Spacing between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page side gutter under 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-md
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 768px to 1279px.

tokens.name: gutter-lg
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from 1280px.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Age-rating badge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Posters and artwork thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, sheets, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, genre chips, icon buttons: every control is a pill or a circle.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Red glow under primary buttons and selected chips.

tokens.name: shadow-poster
tokens.usage: Poster lift on hover and focus.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Top edge of the bottom nav on phones.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on touch screens.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Top nav height from 768px.

tokens.name: nav-height-sm
tokens.usage: Top nav height under 768px.

tokens.name: bottom-nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom nav height on phones, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Buttons at size md.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Genre chips (40px on coarse pointers).

tokens.name: poster-width-sm
tokens.usage: Poster card width under 768px (about 2.6 cards visible on a 375px phone).

tokens.name: poster-width-lg
tokens.usage: Poster card width from 768px.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: hero buttons go side by side.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: top-nav links appear, bottom nav hides, hero switches to the overlay layout.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptop: poster-row arrows appear on hover-capable pointers.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop: gutter-lg; content max width 1440px.

tokens.name: z-row-arrows
tokens.usage: Poster-row arrows over posters.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky top nav and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus and dialogs.
